review_basis.integrity: All 186 unique, sorted manifest entries match the snapshot and current workspace bytes; the SHA-256 of the canonical compact sorted-key JSON array matches the package root. The snapshot contains no additional files.
review_basis.scope: Approval is for the frozen, inactive implementation contract only, subject to its six-seat and two-clean-build prerequisites. The registered verifier and all 36 elaborated type and axiom records were inspected; this review does not assert that the verifier has run or that Lean proves implementation correspondence.
review_basis.safety: The contract replaces cross-request process reuse with one-use generations, retains the shared two-tree accounting and the active permit, and requires generation-owned positive cleanup, fresh CLEAN authority, staged publication and a final build fence. Uncertain cleanup and incomplete restart reconciliation fail closed. Actual OS, adapter, journal, cancellation and descriptor behavior remain runtime obligations.
review_basis.feasibility: The r4 probe is bounded evidence of image byte transport, seals, limits and cleanup, not Alloy initialization, private validation, semantic equivalence or performance. The fixed in-sandbox prlimit step and setup file limit must be tested on the actual implementation. Earlier failed probes remain relevant evidence.
review_basis.prior_rejection: Reviewed the rejected validator-session findings independently. This proposal avoids its shared-JVM reset premise and specifies image transport, process ownership, guarded reachability and full elaborated theorem types. Its safety and performance prerequisites still require actual implementation evidence; the prior rejection is not converted into a runtime approval.

conditions_and_boundary: Production preview remains fresh DEFAULT; no live activation follows from this review or model verification. Material contract changes require renewed review and proof as specified. Frozen runtime fixtures, independent finite safety and differential checks, actual owned-cgroup tests, and all preregistered performance gates remain prerequisites to selection. Workstation quotas do not establish actual 4 vCPU / 8 GiB target-host performance. Commercial release remains NO_GO and target-host acceptance OPEN. All Java, JavaScript and TypeScript methods must be documented and at most 30 physical lines; all PostgreSQL access, including observations and administration, remains through SQLeanParser.
